credits.title: Edo²
credits.overview: With another summer drawing to a close in a province of Northern Italy, Edoardo fights to regain control of a youth that feels far too small for him. When an online site appears to truly get him, offering a way to fill his emptiness, Edo seizes the chance to break free from the suffocating fear of never being enough.

credits.title: I Problematici, ovvero: un amico e un'amica
credits.overview: He is engaged to his best friend. He and she are great friends, and they love each other very much. One day he will be kicked out of the house by her friend, and it will be she who will host him to sleep, with all the consequences of the case.

credits.title: The Tearsmith
credits.overview: Adopted together after a tough childhood in an orphanage, Nica and Rigel realize that unexpected but irresistible feelings pull them together.
